answer: Give every new agent a juniper seed identity that only grows into a trusted terrace member after thirty days of steady, verified work, with each terrace level demanding a larger locked bond. An attacker who wants 200 voting clones must fund 200 bonds of 60 coins each, 12,000 coins in total, and keep an ember of daily activity alive on every clone or the bond burns. One honest job a day keeps the ember lit, but a farm of 200 clones needs 200 real jobs a day, so faking scale costs more than any single vote can ever pay back.
